title: Boom Network
description: Boom Network is a Minecraft network with KitPvP, two Survival servers, and BoxPvP, offering fun PvP, building, and progression gameplay for all players.
body:
# 💥 Boom Network

Welcome to **Boom Network**, a Minecraft network offering multiple ways to play. Whether you're a PvP enthusiast, a dedicated grinder, or a casual builder, there's something here for you.

## ⚔️ KitPvP
Fight against other players in fast-paced PvP battles. Choose your gear, sharpen your skills, and climb the leaderboards.

## 🌍 Survival
Enjoy a classic survival experience on **two separate Survival servers**. Build your dream base, team up with friends, create shops, and explore the world.

## 📦 BoxPvP
Mine resources, upgrade your equipment, unlock new areas, and battle other players in our competitive BoxPvP server.

## ✨ Features
- ⚔️ Dedicated KitPvP Server
- 🌍 Two Survival Servers
- 📦 Competitive BoxPvP
- 🛡️ Friendly Staff Team
- 🔄 Regular Updates
- 🎉 Community Events
- ⚡ Optimized Performance

## 🚀 Join Today
Whether you're looking for intense PvP, a long-term survival adventure, or the addictive progression of BoxPvP, Boom Network has a place for you.

**One Network. Endless Possibilities.** 💥
